#FreeAmade: Journalist arrested and tortured after reporting on violence in northern Mozambique
#FreeAmade: ɗan siyasar da aka kama kuma aka azabtar a bayan rahoto game da tashin hankalin arewacin Mozambiƙue

Translate the following text from English to Hausa.

Survivors who lost relatives and houses rest outside following the June 5 attack in the village of Naunde in Cabo Delgado, Mozambique.
Waɗanda suka tsira waɗanda suka rasa 'yan'uwansu da gidajensu suna zaune a waje bayan harin 5 ga Yuni a ƙauyen Naunde a Cabo Delgado, a Mozambiƙue.
